subject: Request: exec intro + infrastructure deep-dive to unblock POC
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Li <evan.li@fabrica.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request: exec intro + infrastructure deep-dive to unblock POC

Hi Evan —

Thanks again for the call today — good cadence and clear need around powering multi-tenant inference with lower latency and predictable cost. Quick recap and proposed next step to keep momentum: 

Summary (short):
- Primary goal: run a 6–8 week POC to validate latency at scale and cost per inference for your core recommendation engine.
- Key constraints: data residency in US-east, NFRs: 99.9% uptime for inference, request-level logging for audits.
- Current blockers: exec alignment (VP/CTO to sign off on pilot runway) and a technical deep-dive to finalize infra sizing & security posture.

Next step I propose:
- A 45-minute executive intro (VP/CTO handshake) to align success criteria + decision authority, followed immediately by a 60-minute infrastructure deep-dive with engineering & security to lock the pilot runbook.

Suggested attendees: your CTO (for exec intro) and lead infra engineer; from our side Karthik Iyer (solutions lead) + Marissa Cole (CS).

Can you share 3 windows that work for your team next week (Mon/Tue/Wed preferred)? If helpful, I can propose specific slots. I included a one-page proposed agenda in the linked doc: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-proposed-agenda

Also flagging a couple of items we’ll cover in the infra deep-dive so your team can prep: expected peak qps, sample traffic distribution, accepted cryptography/KMS flows, and any compliance evidence needed.

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time and getting the POC started.

— Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
https://calendly.com/redwood/dylan-30m

Attachment: proposed-agenda.md (text)
From: Evan Li <evan.li@fabrica.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@fabrica.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 17:48:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: exec intro + infrastructure deep-dive to unblock POC

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the clear recap. Maria (cc'ed) is our CTO and definitely wants to join the exec intro. A couple quick notes before we schedule: 

- We do need the POC to be US-only for initial data residency — that aligns with your note.
- Security will want to see a list of logs/retention and any KMS/HSM integrations ahead of the deep-dive; can that be covered during the infra session?

Availability next week (PST) for an exec + tech block:
- Mon Aug 2: 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–16:30
- Tue Aug 3: 09:00–11:00

If none of those work, we can push to later in the week. Please propose a concrete slot and we'll confirm. Also share any short pre-reads you recommend.

Best,
Evan
Evan Li
Head of Platform, Fabrica AI
evan.li@fabrica.ai

Appreciate the quick response, Evan — copying Karthik and Marissa so they can join the sessions.

Two concrete options that match your windows:
- Option A: Mon Aug 2, 10:30–12:00 PST — 30m exec intro (10:30–11:00) + 60m infra deep-dive (11:00–12:00)
- Option B: Tue Aug 3, 09:30–11:00 PST — same split (09:30–10:00 exec, 10:00–11:00 infra)

Pre-reads: short pilot runbook + proposed agenda (both under the Drive link I mentioned). I also added a one-slide security checklist that answers the initial KMS/logging questions.

If one of those works, I'll send a calendar invite and include a short Teams link + the runbook.

Thanks,
— Dylan

Hi all — I can join on Monday 10:30 PST. Per the infra deep-dive I attached a short pilot-runbook and an infra checklist to accelerate decisions: pilot-runbook.pdf (high-level milestones + success criteria), infra-checklist.xlsx (sizing matrix + firewall/KMS questions).

1) Traffic profile & capacity planning (15m)
2) Network topology & data residency controls (15m)
3) Latency targets, measurement plan, and rollback policies (15m)
4) Evidence and audit logs for compliance (15m)

See you Monday — I’ll send the invite once Evan confirms.

Thanks,
